title: Dangerous .NET construct (machinedec) — review required
description: .NET weakens a control: decryptionKeys*=s*"[0-9A-Fa-f]{16,} (machinedec). Polymorphic typing enables gadgets, XSLT scripts execute, certificate callbacks accept all, plaintext mail and HTTP leak data, and validation opt-outs invite script. This lexical rule flags the construct; the reviewer hardens via generated keys.
